claims.statement: With 0 failures in n independent Bernoulli(p) trials, the one-sided 95% upper confidence bound on p is $1-0.05^{1/n}$.
dependencies: Bernoulli distribution cumulative probability model under independent and identically distributed sampling.
Clopper-Pearson exact confidence interval inversion for zero observed failures.
Planning calculations in Paper 003 Section 7 lines 505-511.
claims.limits: Assumes identically distributed and strictly independent trials; correlated proposal distributions, shared prompt fixtures, or multi-turn dependencies invalidate direct application of the bound.

claims.statement: The historical experiment_manifest.yaml disables the planned live experiment.

claims.limits: Records the administrative execution flags of the pinned historical manifest; does not evaluate preliminary pilots or configurations on uninspected branches.

claims.statement: The stored live pilot receipt does not establish the frozen randomized study.
dependencies: Frozen six-arm randomized study design specified in Paper 003 Section 6.
claims.limits: Assesses the historical pilot receipt against confirmatory experimental standards; does not dispute the exploratory engineering value of the descriptive trial log.
